about: Test questions for the CSULB Services RAG Assistant. Run with: npm run test:questions (the app must be running: npm run dev). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions, checked against the answer text plus the titles of its source chips and suggested page.

tests.question: How much is a semester student parking permit?
tests.expected_behavior: Answers with the semester price and cites a parking source.

tests.question: Who are the international student advisors?
tests.expected_behavior: Names the three International Student Advisors from the Staff Contacts page.
tests.expected_fact: Ignacio Castor, Tammy Guzman, Angela Garris

tests.question: What is the last day to drop a class without a W in Spring 2027?
tests.expected_behavior: The source lists two dates for this deadline. The answer shows both and tells the student to confirm with the office.

tests.question: How do I check my financial aid status?
tests.expected_behavior: Explains where to look in MyCSULB (To Do List or View Financial Aid).
tests.expected_fact: To Do List / View Financial Aid

tests.question: What are the Technology Help Desk hours?
tests.expected_behavior: Gives the phone support hours (until 7 p.m. Monday-Thursday).

tests.question: How much does Day 1 Textbook Access cost?
tests.expected_behavior: Gives the Day 1 Textbook Access bundle price.

tests.question: How do I sign up for SOAR orientation?
tests.expected_behavior: Explains SOAR reservations open in SSO on November 3, 2026.

tests.question: Where can I get help with my resume?
tests.expected_behavior: Points to the Career Development Center (appointments through Beach Connect, or its Brotman Hall office).

tests.question: What hours does the campus shuttle run?
tests.expected_behavior: Gives shuttle hours (East/West Loop Mon.-Thurs., 7 a.m.-7 p.m.).

tests.question: How do I contact the Basic Needs office?
tests.expected_behavior: Gives the Basic Needs phone number or email.

tests.question: How do I pay my tuition fees online?
tests.expected_behavior: Explains the 'Make a Payment' steps in the MyCSULB Student Center.

tests.question: Where do computer science majors go for academic advising?
tests.expected_behavior: Names the right advising center and gives its link, without making up a phone number.
tests.expected_fact: Computer Science Faculty Advising / Engineering Student Success Center

tests.question: Where can I get free groceries on campus?
tests.expected_behavior: Points to the Beach Pantry.

tests.question: Does Student Health Services offer immunizations?
tests.expected_behavior: Confirms immunizations are listed under Medical Services.

tests.question: How do I apply?
tests.expected_behavior: Asks a clarifying question listing the likely options instead of guessing.
tests.expected_fact: Asks: admission, scholarships, graduation, financial aid...?

tests.question: When is the deadline?
tests.expected_behavior: Asks which deadline the student means instead of guessing.

tests.question: Where are the nearest taco spots near campus?
tests.expected_behavior: Falls back (off-campus question), even though an on-campus taco stand is in the sources.
